units.source_text: 把古色古香的镜子揩拭干净了。

en.t: I wiped the antique-looking mirror clean.
The mirror in early summer was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 真想把那道山峡映在朱漆带把儿的小镜子里。

en.t: I truly wanted to reflect that mountain gorge in the small vermilion-lacquered mirror with a handle.

units.source_text: 那是一道艳丽的细细的峡谷，简直好像一条油画腰带似的。

en.t: It was a brilliant, slender gorge, just like a belt painted in oils.
